name: fix-all-issues
description: Bounded PR review and remediation through fresh outer-round worker pools. Attributes every verified finding, fixes responsibility owned by the candidate, routes adjacent issues durably, consolidates repeated root causes, and binds review and validation to exact Git trees and body phases.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded PR review with exact-tree evidence and durable issue routes
interface.longDescription: Orchestrate a bounded PR review and repair loop while the main agent stays available. Each outer round gets a fresh coordinator and blind pool, then reuses a small fixed worker set for batched verification, independent triage, disjoint fixes, root-cause consolidation, cold confirmation, tree-keyed validation, and delivery. A responsibility envelope keeps candidate-caused and direct-caller fixes in the PR while verified adjacent and product issues receive durable routes. Terminal states distinguish clean, scope-routed, blocked, stabilized, and capped runs.
defaultPrompt: Review my current branch against main and fix every issue you find
